country: # Neusiedler See: very shallow steppe lake (mostly standing depth)
region: kiting only in the marked zones; season roughly April–October.

name: Podersdorf am See (Neusiedler See)
notes: East shore: Austria's main kite spot, shallow standing water; best in NW winds. Kite zone with schools. Also: Breitenbrunn on the west shore (works in SE–E winds).

name: Neusiedl am See
notes: North end of the lake: shallow water, kite zone by the Seebad at the end of the causeway through the reeds; best in NW and SE winds.
